test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given below to fill in the blank in the following sentence.**

Imminent

The king was changing his hiding place every now and then because of ______ danger to his life.
solution:
The correct answer is **"approaching."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Imminent"** means something that is about to happen or occur. ((प्रायः अप्रिय बात) बहुत शीघ्र लगभग निश्‍चित रूप से घटित होने वाली; सन्निकट, आसन्‍न, अवश्‍यंभावी)

 
 
• **Example**: *Heavy rainfall means that flooding is **imminent**__.*
 
 
 
• **Approaching** is a synonym of **imminent.**
 
• ​It means something that is coming closer or nearer. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो निकट या समीप आ रही हो)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The ship is **approaching**__.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the danger to the king's life is about to happen or occur soon, hence imminent danger.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**:* **The king was changing his hiding place every now and then because of __**approaching**__ danger to his life. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "happening"**, is not a synonym of imminent. It means something that is currently occurring or taking place. (जो घटित होता है; घटना (प्रायः विचित्र और पेचीदा))
 
• **Option 3, "participating"**, is not a synonym of imminent. It means taking part in an activity or event. (किसी काम में भाग लेना या उससे जुड़ जाना)
 
• **Option 4, "losing"**, is not a synonym of imminent. It means being defeated or suffering a loss. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) खो देना, न पा सकना)
